name: cellcell-crossfeed
description: A tuned two-role cross-feeding pair (CpmColonyField) on a shared 60x60 grid demonstrating a metabolic handoff. A 'secretor' CPM cell runs the flagship microaerobic e_coli_core loop -- dynamic MM-limited glucose uptake (glucose_vmax 10.0) with O2 capped hard at 5.0 to force maximal mixed-acid acetate overflow -- and is fed by a LOCALIZED glucose depot (20.0 mM in the left columns 0-18, zero elsewhere) so glucose never reaches the consumer and the secretor plateaus once the depot is spent. A 'consumer' CPM cell has its glucose exchange fixed off (role-driven) and instead runs dynamic MM-limited ACETATE uptake (acetate_vmax 20.0) with O2 uncapped-ish (oxygen_vmax 20.0) to respire it. The two cells are seeded ~6 lattice cells apart (secretor x8-16, consumer x22-30) and acetate carries a high diffusion coefficient (15.0, vs glucose 0.4) so the secretor's plume crosses the open field and reaches the consumer's footprint before it starves. Over a 20-step run the consumer sits at ~zero local glucose, its local acetate rises as the plume arrives, and it net-grows on acetate alone (biomass 1.25 -> ~3.8). Regime tuned + asserted in task 4 (tests/test_cellcell_regimes.py).
